1 // shark-tank.mjs — Crucible's adversarial review round (Wave 2).
2 //
3 // A Shark Tank is one round of adversarial review: three INDEPENDENT, fresh-
4 // context Sharks (Skeptic / Contrarian / Analyst) are each handed the North Star
5 // VERBATIM plus a rotated PM critique angle, and prompted to REFUTE the draft.
6 // Their findings are then tallied into a single verdict.
7 //
8 // REUSE, NOT REINVENT (per the project's standing rule + MASTER-PLAN §6):
9 //   - The agent INJECTION contract mirrors Foreman's `makeAgentDriver({ agent })`
10 //     (`wave-workflow.js`): the driver is built from the SAME Wave-1 `agent` seam
11 //     (`makeAgentSeam(...).agent`) you would hand Foreman. We define a Crucible
12 //     `makeSharkDriver({ agent })` rather than calling Foreman's `makeAgentDriver`
13 //     verbatim because its `review()` emits a Foreman-GATE-artifact prompt; the
14 //     more-specific Wave-2 requirement — "each prompt embedding the North Star + a
15 //     rotated PM critique angle" — needs a plan-level Shark prompt instead.
16 //   - The agreement TALLY reuses Foreman's `collectFindings` (`wave-engine.mjs`)
17 //     unchanged; Crucible only adds the cross-Shark id NORMALIZATION in front of
18 //     it (so ≥2-agree fires on the *same* issue even when Sharks word it
19 //     differently) and the inclusion-test DEMOTION behind it.
20 //   - The finding schema extends Foreman's `REVIEW_SCHEMA` with the Crucible
21 //     fields the round mechanic needs (`topic`, `traces_to_north_star`, `tag`).
22

38 /** The three fixed Shark roles (persona = the machinery each channels). */
39 export const SHARK_ROLES = [
40   { role: 'Skeptic', persona: 'Critic' },
41   { role: 'Contrarian', persona: "Devil's-Advocate" },
42   { role: 'Analyst', persona: 'researchPrime' },
43 ];

45 /** PM's 8 critique angles, rotated across Sharks/rounds for diverse pushback. */
46 export const PM_CRITIQUE_ANGLES = [
47   'security',
48   'frustrated-UX',
49   'operator',
50   'skeptical-researcher',
51   'competitor',
52   'bored-investor',
53   'future-maintainer',
54   'steel-man-the-premise',
55 ];

57 /**
58  * The critique angle a given Shark wears this round. Rotates across BOTH the
59  * Shark index and the round number so the same Shark sees fresh angles over a
60  * multi-round loop and no angle is starved.
61  */
62 export function angleForShark(round, sharkIndex, roleCount = SHARK_ROLES.length) {
63   const n = PM_CRITIQUE_ANGLES.length;
64   const rc = Math.max(1, Number(roleCount) || SHARK_ROLES.length);
65   const i = ((round * rc + sharkIndex) % n + n) % n;
66   return PM_CRITIQUE_ANGLES[i];
67 }

69 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
70 // Finding schema — Foreman's REVIEW_SCHEMA + Crucible round fields.
71 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

73 /**
74  * Each Shark finding: a severity, a STABLE `topic` naming the issue (the cross-
75  * Shark convergence key — same issue ⇒ same topic), an inclusion-test verdict
76  * (`traces_to_north_star` + which criterion), and a scope tag. Extends Foreman's
77  * REVIEW_SCHEMA item shape rather than redefining it.
78  */
79 export const SHARK_SCHEMA = {
80   type: 'object',
81   required: ['answerable', 'findings'],
82   properties: {
83     answerable: { enum: ['yes', 'no'] },
84     note: { type: 'string' },
85     findings: {
86       type: 'array',
87       items: {
88         type: 'object',
89         required: ['severity', 'topic', 'traces_to_north_star'],
90         properties: {
91           severity: { enum: ['BLOCKER', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR', 'NIT'] },
92           topic: { type: 'string' },
93           claim_id: { type: ['string', 'null'] },
94           section: { type: 'string' },
95           tag: { enum: ['refinement', 'out-of-scope'] },
96           traces_to_north_star: { enum: ['yes', 'no'] },
97           criterion: { type: ['string', 'null'] },
98           message: { type: 'string' },
99         },
100       },
101     },
102   },
103 };
104 
105 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
106 // Cross-Shark finding identity (normalization).
107 //
108 // Foreman's findingId is `file:line+rule` — right for code, wrong for plan-level
109 // critique where two Sharks describe the SAME issue in different words. Crucible
110 // keys identity on a NORMALIZED topic: lowercase, alphanumeric tokens, stopwords
111 // dropped, then sorted — so "North Star is ambiguous about scope" and "ambiguous
112 // scope in the North Star" collapse to one id and their ≥2 agreement actually
113 // registers. Falls back to a Foreman-style location id only if a Shark omits a
114 // topic.
115 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
116 
117 const STOPWORDS = new Set([
118   'the', 'a', 'an', 'is', 'are', 'was', 'be', 'being', 'been', 'of', 'to', 'about',
119   'on', 'in', 'for', 'and', 'or', 'that', 'this', 'it', 'its', 'too', 'very', 'as',
120   'by', 'at', 'not', 'no', 'but', 'with', 'should', 'must', 'need', 'needs', 'has',
121   'have', 'plan', 'draft', 'there', 'here', 'we', 'you',
122 ]);
123 
124 /** Canonicalize free text into an order- and wording-insensitive identity key. */
125 export function normalizeTopic(s) {
126   const tokens = String(s ?? '').toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]+/g) || [];
127   const kept = tokens.filter((t) => t.length > 1 && !STOPWORDS.has(t));
128   return (kept.length ? kept : tokens).sort().join('-');
129 }
130 
131 /**
132  * Canonicalize an EXPLICIT claim id (e.g. "C3", "claim-heartbeat-cadence"). Unlike
133  * `normalizeTopic` this preserves token ORDER — an id is an identifier, not prose.
134  */
135 function normalizeClaimId(v) {
136   if (v == null) return '';
137   return String(v).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
138 }
139 
140 /** The stable, cross-Shark normalized id for a finding. */
141 export function normalizeFindingId(f) {
142   // An EXPLICIT claim id BEATS the free-text topic slug. When the artifact under
143   // review carries stable claim ids (researchPrime's ledger), reviewers disputing
144   // the same claim must converge on ONE identity even when their topic wording
145   // differs — three reviewers slugging the same claim three ways each counted
146   // agreement:1 and produced a real false-DRY (researchPrime journal 0001,
147   // 2026-07-06). Identity precedence: claim_id > topic > location.
148   const claimKey = normalizeClaimId(f.claim_id ?? f.claimId);
149   if (claimKey) return `claim:${claimKey}`;
150   const topicKey = normalizeTopic(f.topic);
151   if (topicKey) return `topic:${topicKey}`;
152   const scope = normalizeTopic(f.section || f.file) || 'plan';
153   const rule = normalizeTopic(f.rule || f.message) || 'unspecified';
154   return `loc:${scope}::${rule}`;
155 }
156 
157 const SEV_RANK = { BLOCKER: 4, MAJOR: 3, MINOR: 2, NIT: 1 };
158 const sevRank = (s) => SEV_RANK[String(s || '').toUpperCase()] || 0;
159 
160 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
161 // Tally: normalize → reuse Foreman agreement count → inclusion-test demote →
162 // ≥2-agree BLOCKER → dry-round.
163 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
164 
165 /**
166  * Merge per-Shark reviews into a single verdict.
167  *
168  * Steps:
169  *  1. Assign each finding its cross-Shark normalized id and gather per-id facts
170  *     (does ANY Shark trace it to the North Star, the max severity raised, which
171  *     Sharks raised it, tags/criteria/messages).
172  *  2. Reuse Foreman's `collectFindings` for the dedup + agreement count.
173  *  3. DEMOTE any finding that traces to no criterion (the inclusion test as a
174  *     round mechanic) — demoted findings can never be BLOCKERs and cannot hold
175  *     the loop open.
176  *  4. A BLOCKER is a non-demoted BLOCKER/MAJOR with ≥2 Sharks agreeing.
177  *  5. The round is DRY when there is no NEW BLOCKER (ids in `priorBlockerIds`
178  *     are not new — anti-oscillation via the stable id).
179  *
180  * @param {Array<{reviewer:string, findings:object[]}>} reviews
181  * @param {{priorBlockerIds?:string[]}} [o]
182  */
183 export function tallyFindings(reviews, { priorBlockerIds = [] } = {}) {
184   const prior = new Set(priorBlockerIds);
185   const extras = new Map();
186 
187   // (1) normalize ids + accumulate per-id facts.
188   const normReviews = reviews.map((rv) => ({
189     ...rv,
190     findings: (rv.findings || []).map((f) => {
191       const id = normalizeFindingId(f);
192       const e = extras.get(id) || {
193         id, anyTraces: false, severity: 'NIT',
194         roles: new Set(), tags: new Set(), criteria: new Set(),
195         messages: [], section: f.section || f.file || null,
196       };
197       if (String(f.traces_to_north_star).toLowerCase() === 'yes') e.anyTraces = true;
198       if (sevRank(f.severity) > sevRank(e.severity)) e.severity = String(f.severity).toUpperCase();
199       if (rv.reviewer != null) e.roles.add(rv.reviewer);
200       if (f.tag) e.tags.add(f.tag);
201       if (f.criterion) e.criteria.add(f.criterion);
202       if (f.message) e.messages.push(f.message);
203       if (!e.section && (f.section || f.file)) e.section = f.section || f.file;
204       extras.set(id, e);
205       return { ...f, id };
206     }),
207   }));
208 
209   // (2) reuse Foreman's agreement tally (dedup by id, count distinct reviewers).
210   const merged = collectFindings(normReviews);
211 
212   // (3,4,5) assemble Crucible findings with demotion + blocker + new flags.
213   const findings = merged.map((m) => {
214     const e = extras.get(m.id);
215     const demoted = !e.anyTraces; // fails the inclusion test ⇒ cannot hold the loop open
216     const severity = e.severity;
217     const isBlocker = !demoted && (severity === 'BLOCKER' || severity === 'MAJOR') && m.agreement >= 2;
218     return {
219       id: m.id,
220       severity,
221       agreement: m.agreement,
222       demoted,
223       isBlocker,
224       isNew: !prior.has(m.id),
225       traces_to_north_star: e.anyTraces ? 'yes' : 'no',
226       tag: e.tags.has('refinement') ? 'refinement' : ([...e.tags][0] || (demoted ? 'out-of-scope' : null)),
227       criterion: [...e.criteria][0] || null,
228       raisedBy: [...e.roles],
229       section: e.section,
230       message: e.messages[0] || null,
231     };
232   });
233 
234   const blockers = findings.filter((f) => f.isBlocker);
235   const newBlockers = blockers.filter((f) => f.isNew);
236   const demoted = findings.filter((f) => f.demoted);
237   const dry = newBlockers.length === 0;
238   // Quorum floor (2026-07-17): a BLOCKER needs >=2 Sharks to agree, so a round where fewer
239   // than 2 reviewers returned a PARSEABLE review is INCONCLUSIVE — its "dry" would be a FALSE
240   // convergence (no blocker could ever surface). Only an explicit abstain (answerable:'no' —
241   // a rejected call or unparseable-after-retry reply) fails to count; a review present counts.
242   const answered = reviews.filter((r) => r && r.answerable !== 'no').length;
243   const inconclusive = answered < 2;
244   return { findings, blockers, newBlockers, demoted, dry, inconclusive, answered, verdict: dry ? 'DRY' : 'BLOCKED' };
245 }

247 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
248 // The Shark driver — built from the injected Wave-1 `agent` seam.
249 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
250 
251 function sharkPrompt(role, angle, northStar, draft, research = null,
252                      { priorBlockerIds = [], changelog = null, markdownFirst = false } = {}) {
253   // Fresh researchPrime findings flow to the ANALYST Shark only (persona = researchPrime,
254   // MASTER-PLAN §6) — the other Sharks stay deliberately context-fresh.
255   const isAnalyst = role.persona === 'researchPrime' || role.role === 'Analyst';
256   const researchBlock = isAnalyst && research
257     ? [
258         ``,
259         `=== FRESH RESEARCH INPUT (researchPrime — you are the Analyst; weigh this evidence by quality) ===`,
260         typeof research === 'string' ? research : JSON.stringify(research),
261         `=== END RESEARCH ===`,
262       ]
263     : [];
264   // 2026-07 efficiency: tell each Shark what is ALREADY on the blocker register
265   // and what the last revision changed, so its budget goes to NEW ground instead
266   // of re-deriving known findings the tally will discard as not-new. Rigor is
267   // unchanged: the Shark still reads the FULL draft and MAY re-raise anything it
268   // believes is still unresolved (the register is orientation, not a muzzle).
269   const registerBlock = priorBlockerIds.length
270     ? [
271         ``,
272         `=== ALREADY ON THE BLOCKER REGISTER (known topics from prior rounds) ===`,
273         ...priorBlockerIds.map((id) => `  - ${id}`),
274         `These are KNOWN. A finding matching one of these ids counts as not-new in the`,
275         `tally. Spend your effort on NEW failure modes — but if a register item is`,
276         `STILL unresolved in this draft, say so explicitly.`,
277         `=== END REGISTER ===`,
278       ]
279     : [];
280   const changelogBlock = changelog
281     ? [
282         ``,
283         `=== WHAT THE LAST REVISION CHANGED (the reviser's own changelog) ===`,
284         String(changelog),
285         `=== END CHANGELOG ===`,
286       ]
287     : [];
288   return [
289     `You are the ${role.role} Shark (${role.persona}) in a Crucible Shark Tank — an`,
290     `ADVERSARIAL review whose job is to REFUTE this draft, not to praise it. You have`,
291     `fresh context: rely only on what is written below.`,
292     ``,
293     `=== THE NORTH STAR (verbatim — judge every finding against it) ===`,
294     String(northStar),
295     `=== END NORTH STAR ===`,
296     ``,
297     `Press hardest through this PM critique angle: ${angle}.`,
298     ...researchBlock,
299     ...registerBlock,
300     ...changelogBlock,
301     ``,
302     `For EVERY finding emit:`,
303     `  - severity: BLOCKER | MAJOR | MINOR | NIT`,
304     `  - topic: a SHORT, stable phrase naming the ISSUE itself (not your wording) so`,
305     `    other Sharks naming the same issue converge on it`,
306     `  - section: the part of the draft it targets`,
307     `  - tag: refinement | out-of-scope`,
308     `  - traces_to_north_star: yes | no, and (when yes) which criterion`,
309     `  - message: the refutation`,
310     ...(markdownFirst ? [
311       ``,
312       `Because this draft is extremely large, DO NOT output a JSON object.`,
313       `Emit your review in strict Markdown format exactly like this:`,
314       `answerable: yes`,
315       `note: [optional context]`,
316       ``,
317       `## Finding 1`,
318       `severity: BLOCKER`,
319       `topic: [short phrase]`,
320       `section: [section name]`,
321       `tag: refinement`,
322       `traces_to_north_star: yes`,
323       `criterion: [criterion text]`,
324       `message: [your refutation]`,
325     ] : []),
326     ``,
327     `INCLUSION TEST: a finding that does not trace to a North-Star criterion`,
328     `(traces_to_north_star: no) is out-of-scope and will be DEMOTED — do not inflate`,
329     `its severity to keep the loop open.`,
330     ``,
331     `=== DRAFT UNDER REVIEW ===`,
332     String(draft),
333     `=== END DRAFT ===`,
334     ``,
335     lookinAppendix({ northStar }),
336   ].join('\n');
337 }
338 
339 /**
340  * Best-effort recovery of Shark findings from a RAW-TEXT reply for large drafts
341  * where JSON serialization breaks.
342  */
343 export function parseFindingsFromMarkdown(rawText) {
344   const findings = [];
345   let currentFinding = null;
346   let answerable = 'yes';
347   let note = '';
348 
349   // Handle literal \n and missing newlines before keywords
350   let normalizedText = String(rawText).replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
351   normalizedText = normalizedText.replace(/\s+(?:\*\*)?(severity|topic|section|tag|traces_to_north_star|criterion|message|answerable|note)(?:\*\*)?[:\-]/gi, '\n$1:');
352 
353   const lines = normalizedText.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.length > 0);
354   for (const line of lines) {
355     let m;
356     if ((m = line.match(/^(?:##\s*)?(?:\*\*)?Finding[\s\d\:]*(.*)/i))) {
357       currentFinding = {
358         severity: 'NIT',
359         topic: m[1].trim() || 'unnamed finding',
360         section: '',
361         tag: 'refinement',
362         traces_to_north_star: 'yes',
363         criterion: null,
364         message: ''
365       };
366       findings.push(currentFinding);
367     } else if (currentFinding) {
368       if ((m = line.match(/^(?:\*\*)?(severity|topic|section|tag|traces_to_north_star|criterion|message)(?:\*\*)?[:\-\s]+(.*)/i))) {
369         const key = m[1].toLowerCase();
370         const val = m[2].trim();
371         if (key === 'severity') currentFinding.severity = val.toUpperCase();
372         else if (key === 'topic') currentFinding.topic = val;
373         else if (key === 'section') currentFinding.section = val;
374         else if (key === 'tag') currentFinding.tag = val;
375         else if (key === 'traces_to_north_star') {
376            currentFinding.traces_to_north_star = val.toLowerCase().startsWith('no') ? 'no' : 'yes';
377         }
378         else if (key === 'criterion') currentFinding.criterion = val;
379         else if (key === 'message') currentFinding.message = val;
380       }
381     } else {
382        if ((m = line.match(/^(?:\*\*)?answerable(?:\*\*)?[:\-\s]+(.*)/i))) {
383          answerable = m[1].trim().toLowerCase() === 'no' ? 'no' : 'yes';
384        } else if ((m = line.match(/^(?:\*\*)?note(?:\*\*)?[:\-\s]+(.*)/i))) {
385          note = m[1].trim();
386        }
387     }
388   }
389   return { answerable, note, findings };
390 }
391 
392 /**
393  * Build a Shark driver from an injected `agent()` (Wave-1's seam) — same
394  * injection contract as Foreman's `makeAgentDriver({ agent })`.
395  * @param {{agent:(prompt:string,opts?:object)=>Promise<any>}} deps
396  */
397 export function makeSharkDriver({ agent } = {}) {
398   if (typeof agent !== 'function') {
399     throw new HaltError(
400       'makeSharkDriver requires an agent() function',
401       'pass the Wave-1 seam: makeSharkDriver({ agent: makeAgentSeam(...).agent })',
402     );
403   }
404   return {
405     /** Run one Shark over the draft; returns a normalized per-Shark review. */
406     async review(role, { round = 0, northStar, draft, angle, research = null,
407                          priorBlockerIds = [], changelog = null }) {
408       const lens = angle ?? angleForShark(round, SHARK_ROLES.findIndex((r) => r.role === role.role));
409       
410       const markdownFirst = draft.length > 20000;
411 
412       // 2026-09-01 (Gate 5 Stage 2, Ecgberht): a Shark is a one-shot read-only seat
413       // with NO heartbeat trail, so the look-in supervisor's "silence is death"
414       // degenerated into a 90s+60s WALL-CLOCK kill — every reviewer slower than
415       // ~3 min was declared dead (child left running, reply discarded) and the
416       // round reported DRY with 0/2 answerable. Stage 1 merely squeaked under it.
417       // A trail-less seat is given a window sized to a real review instead; the
418       // driver's own per-call timeout stays the dead-process backstop.
419       const seatWindowMs = Number(process.env.CRUCIBLE_SHARK_SEAT_WINDOW_MS) > 0
420         ? Number(process.env.CRUCIBLE_SHARK_SEAT_WINDOW_MS)
421         : SHARK_SEAT_WINDOW_MS;
422       const out = await superviseSeat({
423         run: () => agent(
424           sharkPrompt(role, lens, northStar, draft, research, { priorBlockerIds, changelog, markdownFirst }), {
425             label: `shark:${role.role}:r${round}`,
426             role: 'shark',
427             schema: markdownFirst ? undefined : SHARK_SCHEMA,
428           }),
429         checkInMs: seatWindowMs,
430         silentKillMs: 60 * 1000,
431         deadIdleMs: seatWindowMs,
432       });
433 
434       let answerable, note, findings;
435       if (markdownFirst) {
436         const parsed = parseFindingsFromMarkdown(typeof out === 'string' ? out : '');
437         answerable = parsed.answerable;
438         note = parsed.note;
439         findings = parsed.findings;
440       } else {
441         answerable = out?.answerable ?? 'yes';
442         note = out?.note;
443         findings = Array.isArray(out?.findings) ? out.findings : [];
444       }
445       
446       return {
447         reviewer: role.role,
448         angle: lens,
449         answerable,
450         note,
451         findings,
452       };
453     },
454   };
455 }
456 
457 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
458 // One full Shark-Tank round.
459 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
460 
461 /**
462  * Run all three Sharks over `draft`, tally a verdict, and (optionally) write the
463  * file-based round artifacts.
464  *
465  * @param {object} o
466  * @param {Function} o.agent                    Wave-1 agent seam
467  * @param {string}   o.northStar                embedded verbatim in every Shark prompt
468  * @param {string}   o.draft                    the artifact under review
469  * @param {number}  [o.round=0]
470  * @param {string[]}[o.priorBlockerIds=[]]      ids already blocking (anti-oscillation)
471  * @param {?(string|object)} [o.research=null]  researchPrime findings — embedded into the Analyst Shark only
472  * @param {?string} [o.artifactsDir=null]       when set, writes round artifacts there
473  * @param {Function}[o.log=()=>{}]
474  * @returns {Promise<object>} the round verdict
475  */
476 export async function runSharkTank({
477   agent,
478   northStar,
479   draft,
480   round = 0,
481   priorBlockerIds = [],
482   research = null,
483   changelog = null,
484   artifactsDir = null,
485   /** 2 = LITE concurrent pair; 3 = FULL (default). Floor 2 so ≥2-agree can still fire. */
486   sharkRoles = 3,
487   log = () => {},
488 }) {
489   const driver = makeSharkDriver({ agent });
490   const n = Math.max(2, Math.min(SHARK_ROLES.length, Number(sharkRoles) || 3));
491   const roles = SHARK_ROLES.slice(0, n);
492   const angles = {};
493   const jobs = roles.map((role, i) => {
494     const angle = angleForShark(round, i, n);
495     angles[role.role] = angle;
496     return { role, angle };
497   });
498   // 2026-07 efficiency: the three fresh-context Sharks run CONCURRENTLY (the
499   // port of Foreman's FOREMAN_CONCURRENT_REVIEW pattern — tallyFindings keys on
500   // normalized topic ids and is order-independent, and concurrency only
501   // strengthens independence). A REJECTED Shark maps to an abstain
502   // (answerable:'no', zero findings) — never silently dropped — so the caller's
503   // ambiguity handling sees it, exactly like Foreman's mapping. Set
504   // CRUCIBLE_CONCURRENT_SHARKS=0 to restore the historical serial path.
505   let reviews;
506   if (process.env.CRUCIBLE_CONCURRENT_SHARKS !== '0') {
507     const settled = await Promise.allSettled(jobs.map(({ role, angle }) =>
508       driver.review(role, { round, northStar, draft, angle, research,
509                             priorBlockerIds, changelog })));
510     reviews = settled.map((s, i) => s.status === 'fulfilled' ? s.value : {
511       reviewer: jobs[i].role.role,
512       angle: jobs[i].angle,
513       answerable: 'no',
514       note: `shark ${jobs[i].role.role} call rejected (${s.reason?.message || s.reason}) — abstain`,
515       findings: [],
516     });
517   } else {
518     reviews = [];
519     for (const { role, angle } of jobs) {
520       reviews.push(await driver.review(role, { round, northStar, draft, angle,
521                                                research, priorBlockerIds, changelog }));
522     }
523   }
524 
525   const tally = tallyFindings(reviews, { priorBlockerIds });
526   const verdict = { round, ...tally, angles, reviews };
527   log(
528     `shark-tank round ${round}: ${verdict.verdict} — ${verdict.blockers.length} blocker(s), ` +
529     `${verdict.demoted.length} demoted, ${verdict.findings.length} finding(s)`,
530   );
531 
532   if (artifactsDir) verdict.artifactPath = writeRoundArtifacts(artifactsDir, verdict);
533   return verdict;
534 }
535 
536 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
537 // File-based verdict artifacts.
538 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
539 
540 function renderSynthesis(verdict) {
541   const lines = [
542     `# Shark-Tank Round ${verdict.round} — ${verdict.verdict}`,
543     '',
544     `- Verdict: **${verdict.verdict}** (${verdict.dry ? 'dry round — no new BLOCKER' : `${verdict.newBlockers.length} new BLOCKER`})`,
545     `- Angles: ${Object.entries(verdict.angles).map(([r, a]) => `${r}=${a}`).join(', ')}`,
546     `- Findings: ${verdict.findings.length} · Blockers: ${verdict.blockers.length} · Demoted (inclusion test): ${verdict.demoted.length}`,
547     '',
548     '## Blocking (≥2 Sharks agree, traces to a criterion)',
549   ];
550   if (verdict.blockers.length === 0) lines.push('_none_');
551   for (const f of verdict.blockers) {
552     lines.push(`- **${f.severity}** \`${f.id}\` — agree ${f.agreement} (${f.raisedBy.join(', ')}) — ${f.message ?? ''}`);
553   }
554   lines.push('', '## Demoted (failed the inclusion test — cannot hold the loop open)');
555   if (verdict.demoted.length === 0) lines.push('_none_');
556   for (const f of verdict.demoted) {
557     lines.push(`- ~~\`${f.id}\`~~ traces_to_north_star: no — ${f.message ?? ''}`);
558   }
559   return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
560 }
561 
562 /**
563  * Write the round's verdict artifacts: a machine `verdict.json`, one file per
564  * Shark, and a human-readable `SYNTHESIS.md` (matching the existing
565  * `plans/debates/round-N/SYNTHESIS.md` convention). Returns the round dir.
566  */
567 export function writeRoundArtifacts(baseDir, verdict) {
568   const roundDir = path.join(baseDir, `round-${verdict.round}`);
569   fs.mkdirSync(roundDir, { recursive: true });
570   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(roundDir, 'verdict.json'), JSON.stringify(verdict, null, 2));
571   for (const rv of verdict.reviews) {
572     fs.writeFileSync(path.join(roundDir, `shark-${rv.reviewer}.json`), JSON.stringify(rv, null, 2));
573   }
574   fs.writeFileSync(path.join(roundDir, 'SYNTHESIS.md'), renderSynthesis(verdict));
575   return roundDir;
576 }
